title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 41 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 41)

content.overview: Section 41 addresses the effect of insolvency on arbitration agreements and proceedings, operating subject to the applicable insolvency law and the statutory treatment of the authority of the relevant insolvency representative.

content.study:
Section 41 — Provisions in case of insolvency

Section 41 addresses the effect of insolvency on arbitration agreements and proceedings, operating subject to the applicable insolvency law and the statutory treatment of the authority of the relevant insolvency representative.

The section must be applied by identifying the statutory trigger, connected provisions and procedural consequence. Limitation, insolvency or jurisdictional effects must be determined from the text and applicable statute rather than assumed from general arbitration practice.
